Variants.Content: Bukhara oasis grain, herds, coin credit and Bactrian exchange sustain the court. Excess collection harms merchants and irrigation labor.

Bukhara oasis grain, herds and Bactrian exchange support the court. Traveling followers need real food from this production; valuables still require a buyer and exchange. Excess collection damages trade and irrigation labor.

Excess collection damages trade and irrigation labor. Collectors and distributors depend on the next yield too; extra demands leave losses with continuing suppliers. Bukhara oasis grain, herds and Bactrian exchange support the court.
Bukhara oasis grain, herds and Bactrian exchange support the court. Households need meals and the means to keep producing after delivering goods. Excess collection damages trade and irrigation labor.

Excess collection damages trade and irrigation labor. Traders answer for delivery, acceptable goods and payment; delays affect the next purchase. Bukhara oasis grain, herds and Bactrian exchange support the court.
